scenes.heading: EXT. DESERT OUTSIDE DRY CREEK - DUSK

elements.text: Heat shimmer over the scrub. The sun sits low and orange on the ridge line.
Two RIDERS walk their horses in from opposite directions and stop forty paces apart.
EZRA HALE (60s, sheriff's star long since pawned) rests a hand near his holster. Across from him, MARA VOSS (30s, dust-caked duster) does not blink.
EZRA
You rode a long way to stand in the dirt.
MARA
(evenly)
I rode a long way for the key, Ezra. That car was my father's.
Wind HOWLS across the flats. A HAWK cries somewhere overhead.
EZRA
Then come and take it.
He tosses a brass KEY into the dirt between them. Neither draws. Mara spurs her horse forward, leans down at a gallop and snatches it up.
CUT TO:

scenes.synopsis: Mara faces down the old sheriff for her father's car key.
scenes.outline: Heat shimmer over the scrub. The sun sits low and orange on the ridge line. Two riders walk their horses in from opposite directions and stop forty paces apart.

scenes.heading: EXT. DRY CREEK - MAIN STREET - NIGHT

elements.text: Rain slicks the empty street. A vintage SPORTS CAR tears past the shuttered storefronts, headlights blazing.
A POLICE CAR swings out of a side road behind it, SIREN WAILING, lights strobing red and blue across the wet asphalt.
A few late PATRONS spill out of the bar to watch.
DEPUTY COLE (V.O.)
(over the radio)
Unit four in pursuit, eastbound on Main. She's running without plates.

scenes.outline: Rain slicks the empty street. A vintage sports car tears past the shuttered storefronts, headlights blazing.

scenes.heading: INT. SPORTS CAR (MOVING) - CONTINUOUS

elements.text: Mara grips the wheel, knuckles white. The brass key swings from the ignition.
The radio plays "Blue Desert Rain", an old country song, far too loud.
MARA
Come on, old girl.
She kills the headlights and cuts hard into an alley. Behind her, the police car ROARS straight past the turn.
Mara lets out a breath. Turns the music down.

scenes.outline: Mara grips the wheel, knuckles white. The brass key swings from the ignition.

scenes.heading: EXT. PACIFIC BEACH - SUNSET

elements.text: Waves fold onto wet sand. The sports car sits at the edge of the dunes, still caked in desert dust.
Mara walks barefoot along the waterline, boots in one hand, the brass key in the other. A FEW SURFERS paddle out beyond the break. Gulls wheel overhead.
She stops. Looks at the key for a long moment.
MARA (V.O.)
Some things you carry. Some things you set down.
She throws the key into the surf and keeps walking.
FADE OUT.

scenes.outline: Waves fold onto wet sand. The sports car sits at the edge of the dunes, still caked in desert dust.
